content: Since Prophet 1.1+, PyPI ships prebuilt manylinux x86_64 wheels with a precompiled CmdStan binary bundled inside (~20MB after pruning), so 'pip install prophet' on Streamlit Community Cloud's Debian x86_64 build image should NOT need to compile C++ or download CmdStan from GitHub at build or runtime. However a Streamlit Community Cloud forum thread (unresolved, no working fix documented) shows CmdStanPy's install_cmdstan() fallback path can fail with 'Cannot connect to CmdStan github repo' when the prebuilt-wheel path is bypassed (e.g. conda-based installs, custom cmdstan installs). Empirical validation on this project's actual deploy target remains required per STATE.md, but the risk is lower than a from-scratch build.
